ስለ ገዳሙ አጭር ታሪክ: A brief history of the monastery
የደብረ ዝቋላ ገዳም መሠረት በ6ኛው መቶ ክፍለ ዘመን በዘመነ አ: The foundation of Debre Zqala Monastery is an ancient and historical relic that was laid in the 6th century during the Axum period. It has been serving as the center of Christianity, civilization and education in the southern and central parts of Ethiopia. The monastery was recorded as one of the major landmarks of the world on the world map prepared by the Italian cartographer Fra Mauro in the 15th century.
በ9ኛው መቶ ክፍለ ዘመን በዮዲት ጉዲት ዘመን በርካታ መንፈሳዊ: In the 9th century, during the reign of Judith Gudit, many spiritual relics were destroyed, but the monastery of Zeqala Debrekostur, built by Emperor Gebre Kress, remained hidden. The great righteous Abune Gebre, the Holy Spirit came to the mountain and re-sanctified the monastery. In the 15th century, during the reign of King Zera Jacob, the monastery was strengthened and expanded.
በ16ኛው መቶ ክፍለ ዘመን በግራኝ አህመድ ወረራ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት: In the 16th century, the monastery suffered great damage during the invasion of the leftist Ahmed and was in ruins for three hundred years. The churches that were built and renovated during the time of Emperor Menelik and the queens of the throne increased the magnificence of the monastery.
በፋሽስት ጣሊያን ወረራ ወራሪው ኃይል ገዳሙን በቦምብ ከመደብደቡ: During the occupation of Fascist Italy, the invading force bombed the monastery and massacred the monks. This shows that Zakhala is the land of martyrs, not only of religion, but also of patriotism. During the Derg era, the land was confiscated and the monks were exposed to problems.
